text: The Feyenoord win is an impressive opening statement in Europe. Five-one, with four different Barcelona scorers. It is also one Champions League match. A convincing win in September is evidence of form, not a guarantee about the knockout rounds. Even Feyenoord had a stronger spell after half-time before Barcelona pulled further away. That is why the next tests are so interesting. The schedule includes a trip to Paris Saint-Germain and a home meeting with Manchester City later in the league phase. Those are opportunities to find out whether the same attacking relationships survive against teams that can press, keep the ball, and punish a loose pass. The challenge is not just creating chances when everything is flowing. It is retaining that threat when Barcelona have to defend for longer, or when the first chance does not go in. That is the difference between a frightening start and a complete European contender.
